sloka: गमिष्यामि ततः को मे पुरुष अर्थो भविष्यति ।मम इदम् लन्घनम् व्यर्थम् सागरस्य भविष्यति ॥५-१३-२१॥
transliteration: gamiṣyāmi tataḥ ko me puruṣa artho bhaviṣyati ।mama idam langhanam vyartham sāgarasya bhaviṣyati ॥5-13-21॥

translations.english: "My crossing the ocean, my entry into Lanka and my survey of the demons are all futile.
